title: GOD'S PROVISION
IN EVERY NEED
end: The Provision Table — walk in God's daily provision
stock_queries: still river at dawn with soft mist
ancient stone table in sunlit sanctuary
calm mountain pass at golden hour
gentle stream flowing over smooth rocks
soft light through old stone archway

scenes.a: As you calculate that mounting pressure of your daily expenses, stillness is your strength.
O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good thing.
Lord, quiet the anxious heart that wonders how the bills will be met this week.
You are the Shepherd who provides for every sincere desire placed in Your holy hands.
May our hearts remain focused on Your righteousness, confident that You supply our daily bread.
